actions.action: Preserve arrival-based priority across every reroute.
actions.mechanism: Keep one case identity and immutable arrival time; rank eligible waiting cases by arrival, not team-entry time.
actions.implementation: Store arrival time once, prohibit updates, and append routing history. Break simultaneous-arrival ties with an immutable intake sequence.
actions.check: Reroute an older mistagged case twice; verify it precedes newer cases eligible for the same worker. Repeat with simultaneous arrivals.
actions.risk: Old cases can dominate; monitor delays without resetting timestamps.

actions.action: Gate assignments against qualifications and live roster capacity.
actions.mechanism: Assign only when language, product expertise, urgent-case qualification, and current shift capacity all permit service.
actions.implementation: Use one atomic assignment gate for automated routing and manual transfers. Determine urgency from documented case criteria, never status or spending.
actions.check: Test concurrent assignments, wrong tags, shift changes, and no eligible urgent worker; forbidden assignments must remain zero.
actions.risk: Incorrect qualification records can defeat otherwise correct checks.

actions.action: Separate skill shortages from missing customer information.
actions.mechanism: Explicit blocker fields explain why cases wait without altering their original arrival-based claim.
actions.implementation: Track missing information and unavailable skills independently, allowing both. Show owners and next steps; resume ready cases using original arrival time.
actions.check: Remove each blocker separately; verify remaining blockers stay visible. With no eligible urgent worker, show skill waiting and notify the lead.
actions.risk: Unreviewed blocker labels can hide actionable cases indefinitely.

actions.action: Run bounded reviews of repeatedly rerouted cases.
actions.mechanism: A small correction batch addresses routing errors while preserving capacity for ordinary service.
actions.implementation: Set a batch limit and roster-based go/no-go threshold. Review tag evidence without assignment; pause if coverage falls, leaving cases queued with original timestamps.
actions.check: Seed incorrect tags; audit corrected requirements and unchanged timestamps. Reduce roster capacity mid-review and verify the batch pauses.
actions.risk: Review can consume scarce expertise; unresolved requirements must block assignment.
